name: minimax-m3.1-flash
description: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a multimodal model from MiniMax. Compared with M3, it delivers significant improvements across multiple benchmarks, particularly in complex agentic tasks, coding, and cybersecurity. It is built for complex, multi-step co-work automation, understanding real codebases, fixing bugs, and building features, and visual understanding and creation, including frontend and presentation creation. Open weights are planned.
zhDescription: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 是 MiniMax 推出的多模态模型。相比 M3，其在多项基准测试中显著提升，尤其擅长复杂智能体任务、编程与网络安全。模型面向复杂的多步骤协作自动化，可理解真实代码库、修复缺陷、开发功能，并支持视觉理解与内容创作，包括前端界面和演示文稿生成。模型权重计划后续开放。
